path_distance_check.note: Both graphs retain a finite set of local travel directions. Refining step size tests discretization but does not remove directional graph bias or certify exact geodesics.

caveats: Known controls supply grid connectivity. These are sampled drawings, not a recovered unknown manifold.
Linear PCA optimizes reconstruction variance. MDS fits distances and is not a globally optimal guarantee.
Geodesic unfolding uses local parameter paths, including edge midpoints; it approximates along-sheet distances.
2D foldovers can create false visual neighbors. A point's image can be retrieved from stored samples, but that is not a learned decoder.
No 2D view here is claimed to preserve all 784-dimensional geometry or reconstruct every continuous image exactly.

understanding_check.object: Connected image samples from one width/lean sheet, not knob coordinates used as plot positions

understanding_check.reference: Root image marked and centered at zero in all layouts
understanding_check.evidence: Distance errors, local edge distortion, foldovers, and held-out PCA reconstruction quantify missing geometry
understanding_check.scope: Finite fixed-center fixed-height slice; geodesic approximation and sampling distribution explicitly stated
